arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Zinn argued sovereign immunity should not bar enforcement.
She noted the district court found ongoing federal law violations.
Mr. Cruz asked if district courts are immune from sovereign immunity.
He stated federal law requires a specific outcome here.
